arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS Customer, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Amount FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'GB' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: 2025 GB Customer Totals
arguments.body: Here is the total amount ordered in 2025 by each GB customer.
